title: Business Research Insights Estimates Expert Network Market at $4.86B in 2026
summary: Business Research Insights estimates the global expert network market at $4.86 billion in 2026, up from $4.19B in 2025, projected to reach $18.03B by 2034 at a 16% CAGR. Note: this estimate uses a different methodology than Inex One's ~$3B figure for 2025, which counts only direct expert-network revenue. BRI's broader scope includes adjacent services.
whyItMatters: Independent market sizing confirms the expert network industry is approaching $5B, with projections to $18B by 2034 — validating strong secular growth.
